# 1. Initialize the project architecture

```{r initialize-architecture}
project_root <- normalizePath(
  getwd(),
  winslash = "/",
  mustWork = TRUE
)

cat("Project root:\n", project_root, "\n\n")

# Basic project checks
rproj_files <- list.files(
  project_root,
  pattern = "\\.Rproj$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

cat(
  "RStudio project file found:",
  length(rproj_files) > 0,
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Git repository found:",
  dir.exists(file.path(project_root, ".git")),
  "\n\n"
)

# Planned ScupSchool architecture
directories <- c(
  # Course-level operational pages
  "course",

  # Four pedagogical modules
  "modules/01-introduction",
  "modules/02-brainstorming",
  "modules/02-brainstorming/02-problem-identification",
  "modules/03-project-development",
  "modules/04-pitch",

  # Optional knowledge base
  "support",

  # Reusable Quarto fragments
  "_includes",

  # Source templates for new pages
  "_templates",

  # Shared design resources
  "assets/styles",
  "assets/images/shared",
  "assets/icons",

  # Development utilities
  "dev"
)

for (directory in directories) {
  full_path <- file.path(project_root, directory)

  dir.create(
    full_path,
    recursive = TRUE,
    showWarnings = FALSE
  )
}

# Git does not track empty directories.
# Temporary .gitkeep files make the empty architecture visible in GitHub.
for (directory in directories) {
  gitkeep_path <- file.path(
    project_root,
    directory,
    ".gitkeep"
  )

  if (!file.exists(gitkeep_path)) {
    file.create(gitkeep_path)
  }
}

cat("Folder architecture created successfully.\n")
```

# 2. Check Quarto and Git

```{r check-tools}
quarto_path <- Sys.which("quarto")
git_path <- Sys.which("git")

cat(
  "Quarto executable:",
  if (nzchar(quarto_path)) quarto_path else "NOT FOUND",
  "\n"
)

if (nzchar(quarto_path)) {
  quarto_version <- system2(
    quarto_path,
    "--version",
    stdout = TRUE,
    stderr = TRUE
  )

  cat(
    "Quarto version:",
    paste(quarto_version, collapse = " "),
    "\n"
  )
}

cat(
  "\nGit executable:",
  if (nzchar(git_path)) git_path else "NOT FOUND",
  "\n"
)

if (
  nzchar(git_path) &&
  dir.exists(file.path(project_root, ".git"))
) {
  git_status <- system2(
    git_path,
    c(
      "-C",
      shQuote(project_root),
      "status",
      "--short",
      "--branch"
    ),
    stdout = TRUE,
    stderr = TRUE
  )

  cat(
    "\nGit status:\n",
    paste(git_status, collapse = "\n"),
    "\n"
  )
}
```

# 3. Inspect the architecture

```{r inspect-architecture}
project_files <- list.files(
  project_root,
  recursive = TRUE,
  all.files = TRUE,
  no.. = TRUE
)

# Hide Git and local RStudio internals from the displayed result
project_files <- project_files[
  !grepl(
    "^(\\.git|\\.Rproj\\.user)(/|$)",
    project_files
  )
]

cat(
  paste(project_files, collapse = "\n"),
  "\n"
)
```
